description: Dedicated SPIR-V/Vulkan benchmark lane for shader artifact density, validation, dispatcher wall time, and optional pipeline executable telemetry.

cases.title: Vec3 storage-buffer copy
cases.description: First Kain SPIR-V black-box breaker: a std430 Vec3 storage-buffer compute kernel that validates under Vulkan, runs through the same headless Vulkan dispatcher as the C++ reference shader, and emits telemetry.
cases.fairness_note: Kain and C++ use different shader frontends, but both run the same copy contract through the same C++ Vulkan dispatcher, descriptor layout, buffers, command submission, timestamp query, and readback verifier. Host setup time is included in process median; GPU timestamp duration is emitted in sidecar telemetry.

cases.title: Semantic ping-pong supermotion
cases.description: Golden SPIR-V showcase row: a branchy, loop-heavy, vector-math compute kernel rebounds Vec4 state through repeated Vulkan ping-pong rounds, then proves the final state against a CPU oracle while collecting executable telemetry.
cases.fairness_note: Kain and C++ still use different shader frontends, but both execute the same rebound contract through the same C++ Vulkan host, descriptor bindings, repeated ping-pong dispatch schedule, CPU-side oracle, timestamp accumulation, and telemetry sidecar. Process medians include host verification; sidecar duration is pure GPU time summed across rounds.

cases.title: Packed route scatter
cases.description: Branchy packet-transform compute row: each invocation reads one Vec4 packet, routes it through six exact-float semantic branches, and writes the transformed packet back through a shared Vulkan dispatcher with exact CPU-oracle verification.
cases.fairness_note: Kain and C++ still use different shader frontends, but both run the same branchy Vec4 packet-transform contract through the same C++ Vulkan dispatcher, descriptor layout, exact CPU oracle, timestamp query, and telemetry sidecar. This fills the current GPU-lane blind spot around semantic packet-routing kernels rather than pure copy or ping-pong-only work.
